cost: Eight features produce 36 candidates per row; at most twelve rules are retained, with up to thirteen candidate-building iterations, giving O(13*36*N log(36N)) plus string comparison; groups worst-case O(N^3) dedup scans and is rebuilt per prediction; CV clones O(kN) records before learner costs.
description: Load CSV records into P with optional parse defaults; feats yields eight categories; learn repeatedly picks best Laplace singleton/pair among remaining rows, removes covered rows and stores strict majority, retaining at most twelve rules. Prediction/reason admits many passenger feature and training fibers; category bins and rounded fare keys discard numeric precision; boolean result cannot recover rule list or unique outcomes.
limitations: Unique passenger ids for group interpretation; bounded u32 family sums and usize counts; finite ages/fares for meaningful numeric bins; missing labels treated false by learner. No competition files used.
Partial syntax and bounded synthetic helper checks; no command/corpus/model/download effects, universal proof or percentage surrogate.
state: Feature order and BTreeMap candidate order are deterministic for bounded finite inputs. Label ties/default ties false. Group neighbors are direct key intersections, not connected components. Empty cv returns NaN, k=0 executes no folds.
